merge_consideration.common_completed_population: Cases that return accepted SAT/UNSAT/UNKNOWN with native statistics in both arms in all three endpoint repeats; defined prospectively and always reported as conditional.
merge_consideration.endpoint_completed_trace_mismatch: Any difference between two completed results in native status, NativeStats, model, proof or stdout blocks consideration.
merge_consideration.endpoint_completion_differences: A TIMEOUT versus a completed checked solve or returned UNKNOWN is a timing outcome, not a contradictory answer; retain as candidate gain/loss or completion difference, exclude from exact completed-pair comparison, and include in every PAR-2 score.
merge_consideration.endpoint_conflicting_completed_verdicts: Conflicting completed native verdicts or statuses block consideration; a timeout has no completed verdict to compare.
merge_consideration.native_solve_scope: Python packing, native ABI and Python decoding; the separate budget ABI CPU measurement includes native setup, normalization, search and result encoding.
merge_consideration.outcome_if_any_condition_missing: NOT_ESTABLISHED; preserve every negative, mismatch and inconclusive cell. Do not change subset, limits or thresholds after outcomes.
merge_consideration.two_endpoint_timeouts: Retained as censored and inconclusive for trace equivalence; not counted as exact.
